reviews.conclusion: Three visible pause/settings visits occupy approximately 4.75-6.25 s in total. The 6.25 s deficit lies at the upper edge of these proxy bounds. Another approximately 2.5-3.0 s has a narrowed/obscured game window, whose pause state is unknown. Ordinary menu/window-management behavior is established, but exact GUI-clock accounting remains unresolved.
Two visible menu visits occupy approximately 2.5-3.5 s in total, compatible with the 2.85 s deficit. The second visit includes a web-link confirmation dialog followed by pause/options screens.
Two settings/video-settings visits span combined transition bounds 1.5-2.5 s, compatible with the 2.217 s deficit.

Death and respawn are directly visible before a pause/video-settings visit spanning transition bounds 1.0-1.5 s, compatible with the 1.217 s deficit. HUD state changes at death; no whole-attempt continuity assumption is made.

A visible pause/video-settings visit after a portal transition lasts approximately 1.0-1.5 s, compatible with the 1.1667 s deficit. Later context also shows window narrowing, beginning after the flagged bracket; it is not used to explain this deficit.

An options/video-settings visit during nether traversal occupies approximately 0.75-1.25 s, compatible with the -1.15 s deficit. Inventory use before and after the menu is not automatically counted as paused.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
